mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drugs (drugs_name, nums, drugs_image, category_id, price, people, use_method, cid, rid, product_time, save_time, status) VALUES (#{drugsName}, #{nums}, #{drugsImage}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{people}, #{useMethod}, #{cid}, #{rid}, #{productTime}, #{saveTime}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE drugs SET drugs_name = #{drugsName}, nums = #{nums}, drugs_image = #{drugsImage}, category_id = #{categoryId}, price = #{price}, people = #{people}, use_method = #{useMethod}, cid = #{cid}, rid = #{rid}, product_time = #{productTime}, save_time = #{saveTime}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
